findings.problem: The hint only rules out klettern, so besteigen, hochsteigen or (because of the word into) einsteigen would also fit to climb.
findings.fix: hint: the basic verb, as in auf den Berg ___ or in den Bus ___; not klettern

back.target: to climb, to go up (also to get on, into or off a vehicle)

note: English stile really is related to steigen, so the trick is sound as well as memorable.
